text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. A useful framework is to create SMART goals, which means they are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. Once the main objectives are set, it helps to break the project into smaller milestones. These act as checkpoints to track progress and keep the team motivated. Regularly defining clear deliverables—the tangible outputs or results—for each stage is also crucial. Finally, ensure strong stakeholder alignment by communicating the goals early and often. When everyone involved shares the same vision and understands their role, the project has a much higher chance of staying on track.
